_comment: AUTEF v2 benchmark sample. Three projects, chosen so the sample varies on
the two things that matter: project LAYOUT and how well the project is
appdirs   flat layout   3 tests, main module untested  -> generation
All three were verified with `autef2 check` and process in under 10
seconds each with no dependency installation, so the whole benchmark can
be re-run cheaply while you tune it.
fault_kinds is declared deliberately. The baseline (v1) repairs a failing
test FUNCTION, so a file-scoped failure -- broken_import, broken_setup --
is one it cannot attempt at all. Seeding those measures reach, not repair
quality. This manifest therefore seeds only per-test faults, so both arms
can attempt every observation. Run manifest_reach.json separately to
measure the file-scoped case, and report the two apart.
